mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repo_conclusion (tenant_id, repo_id, purpose, key_business, upstreams, downstreams, summary_md, ai_session_id, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{repoId}, #{purpose}, #{keyBusiness}, #{upstreams}, #{downstreams}, #{summaryMd}, #{aiSessionId}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repo_conclusion WHERE repo_id = #{repoId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE repo_conclusion SET purpose = #{purpose}, key_business = #{keyBusiness}, upstreams = #{upstreams}, downstreams = #{downstreams}, summary_md = #{summaryMd}, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE repo_conclusion SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE repo_id = #{repoId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0
